summary.headline: Spear-Bearings of the Sun
summary.text: Astrological outcomes of the Moon’s lack of connection with Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury, followed by Chapter 53 on the Sun’s spear-bearings and their effects from Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury. The text then introduces 32 varied appellations for zodiac-sign formations, including authoritative, subordinate, terrestrial, and aquatic types.
